<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_gegis_ins_policy.PlaybookActivitySync</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>PlaybookActivitySync</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var PlaybookActivitySync = Class.create();
PlaybookActivitySync.prototype = {

    type: 'PlaybookActivitySync',
    SYNC_FLAG: 'x_gegis_playbook_syncing',

    initialize: function() {},

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ENTRY POINT: Activity State Sync
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    /**
     * Called when a playbook activity transitions to a terminal state.
     * Finds matching activities (same name + same associated_record) in
     * OTHER contexts and advances them to the same state.
     *
     * Key insight: activities in parallel playbook contexts that represent
     * the same work share both `name` and `associated_record`. This single
     * query replaces complex context resolution and unreliable CONTAINS searches.
     */
    syncActivity: function(activityContextGR) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync.syncActivity: ';

        // Prevent infinite recursion
        if (gs.getSession().getClientData(this.SYNC_FLAG) == 'true') {
            gs.info(LOG + 'SKIP - sync flag active (recursion guard)');
            return;
        }

        var newState = activityContextGR.getValue('state');
        var actName = activityContextGR.getValue('name') || '';
        var contextId = activityContextGR.getValue('context');
        var associatedRecord = activityContextGR.getValue('associated_record');

        gs.info(LOG + 'ENTER - name: "' + actName + '", state: ' + newState +
                ', context: ' + contextId + ', associated_record: ' + associatedRecord);

        // Skip infrastructure/stage activities
        if (!actName || actName.indexOf('$') > -1) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'EXIT - infrastructure activity (contains $)');
            return;
        }

        // Must have an associated_record to find matching activities
        if (!associatedRecord) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'EXIT - no associated_record, cannot find matching activities');
            return;
        }

        // Find ALL matching activities in OTHER contexts
        var targetGR = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_activity_context');
        targetGR.addQuery('associated_record', associatedRecord);
        targetGR.addQuery('name', actName);
        targetGR.addQuery('context', '!=', contextId);
        targetGR.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', 'COMPLETE,CANCELLED,SKIPPED,BYPASSED');
        targetGR.query();

        var targetCount = targetGR.getRowCount();
        gs.info(LOG + 'found ' + targetCount + ' target(s) to sync');

        if (targetCount === 0) return;

        gs.getSession().putClientData(this.SYNC_FLAG, 'true');
        try {
            while (targetGR.next()) {
                var targetId = targetGR.getUniqueValue();
                var targetCtx = targetGR.getValue('context');
                gs.info(LOG + 'syncing target: ' + targetId + ' in ctx ' + targetCtx);
                this._advanceActivity(targetGR, newState, activityContextGR);
            }
        } finally {
            gs.getSession().putClientData(this.SYNC_FLAG, 'false');
        }

        gs.info(LOG + 'DONE - synced "' + actName + '" → ' + newState + ' to ' + targetCount + ' target(s)');
    },

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ENTRY POINT: Context State Sync
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    /**
     * Called when an overall playbook context reaches a terminal state.
     * Advances matching contexts (same process_definition + same case).
     */
    syncContextState: function(contextGR) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync.syncContextState: ';

        if (gs.getSession().getClientData(this.SYNC_FLAG) == 'true') return;

        var newState = contextGR.getValue('state');
        var contextId = contextGR.getUniqueValue();
        var processDefId = contextGR.getValue('process_definition');

        gs.info(LOG + 'ENTER - context: ' + contextId + ', state: ' + newState + ', process_def: ' + processDefId);

        // Find sibling contexts: same process_definition, same input relationship
        // that are still active
        var caseInfo = this._resolveCaseFromContext(contextGR);
        if (!caseInfo) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'EXIT - cannot resolve case from context');
            return;
        }

        gs.info(LOG + 'case: ' + caseInfo.table + ':' + caseInfo.id);

        // Find other contexts running the same playbook for the same case
        var siblingContexts = this._findSiblingContexts(processDefId, caseInfo, contextId);
        if (siblingContexts.length === 0) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'EXIT - no sibling contexts found');
            return;
        }

        gs.getSession().putClientData(this.SYNC_FLAG, 'true');
        try {
            for (var i = 0; i < siblingContexts.length; i++) {
                this._advanceContext(siblingContexts[i], newState);
            }
        } finally {
            gs.getSession().putClientData(this.SYNC_FLAG, 'false');
        }

        gs.info(LOG + 'DONE - synced context state ' + newState + ' to ' + siblingContexts.length + ' sibling(s)');
    },

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ACTIVITY ADVANCEMENT
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    /**
     * Advances a target activity to match the source state.
     *
     * For COMPLETE: sets sys_flow_data state AND directly forces activity state.
     * For SKIPPED/CANCELLED/BYPASSED: forces activity state, then kills backing flow.
     */
    _advanceActivity: function(targetActGR, targetState, sourceActGR) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._advanceActivity: ';
        var targetId = targetActGR.getUniqueValue();

        // Parse locals to check if subflow-backed
        var localsStr = targetActGR.getValue('locals') || '{}';
        var locals;
        try {
            locals = JSON.parse(localsStr);
        } catch (e) {
            locals = {};
        }

        var isSubflowBacked = locals.fdContext && locals.wait_for_completion == 'true';
        gs.info(LOG + targetId + ' → ' + targetState + ' (subflow-backed: ' + isSubflowBacked + ')');

        if (targetState == 'COMPLETE') {
            if (isSubflowBacked) {
                // Complete the sys_flow_data (drives the UI icon + may trigger cascade)
                this._completeFlowData(targetActGR);
            }
            // ALWAYS directly set the activity state as well
            // Use setWorkflow(true) so the playbook engine BRs fire and advance to next activity
            this._setActivityState(targetActGR, 'COMPLETE');
        } else {
            // SKIPPED / CANCELLED / BYPASSED
            // Force the activity state first
            this._setActivityState(targetActGR, targetState);
            // Then kill the backing flow if subflow-backed
            if (isSubflowBacked) {
                this._cancelBackingFlow(locals.fdContext, targetState);
                this._cancelFlowData(targetActGR, targetState);
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Sets activity state. Uses setWorkflow(false) to prevent OUR BR from
     * re-firing (SYNC_FLAG handles this too, but belt-and-suspenders).
     * The playbook engine has its own mechanisms to detect state changes.
     */
    _setActivityState: function(actGR, state) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._setActivityState: ';
        var actId = actGR.getUniqueValue();
        var currentState = actGR.getValue('state');

        if (currentState == state) {
            gs.info(LOG + actId + ' already in state ' + state);
            return;
        }

        // Re-read to avoid stale record issues
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_activity_context');
        if (!gr.get(actId)) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'ERROR - could not re-read activity ' + actId);
            return;
        }

        if (gr.getValue('state') == state) {
            gs.info(LOG + actId + ' already in state ' + state + ' (on re-read)');
            return;
        }

        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        gr.autoSysFields(false);
        gr.setValue('state', state);
        var result = gr.update();
        gs.info(LOG + actId + ' → ' + state + ' (update result: ' + result + ')');
    },

    /**
     * Completes the sys_flow_data record backing a manual activity.
     * This updates the UI icon and may trigger the flow cascade.
     */
    _completeFlowData: function(actGR) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._completeFlowData: ';

        var flowDataId = this._getFlowDataId(actGR);
        if (!flowDataId) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'no experience_status_record found');
            return;
        }

        var fdGR = new GlideRecord('sys_flow_data');
        if (!fdGR.get(flowDataId)) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'sys_flow_data not found: ' + flowDataId);
            return;
        }

        var currentState = fdGR.getValue('state');
        if (currentState == 'COMPLETE') {
            gs.info(LOG + flowDataId + ' already COMPLETE');
            return;
        }

        fdGR.setValue('state', 'COMPLETE');
        var result = fdGR.update();
        gs.info(LOG + flowDataId + ' → COMPLETE (was: ' + currentState + ', result: ' + result + ')');
    },

    /**
     * Cancels/skips the sys_flow_data for non-COMPLETE states.
     */
    _cancelFlowData: function(actGR, targetState) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._cancelFlowData: ';

        var flowDataId = this._getFlowDataId(actGR);
        if (!flowDataId) return;

        var fdGR = new GlideRecord('sys_flow_data');
        if (!fdGR.get(flowDataId)) return;

        if (fdGR.getValue('state') == 'COMPLETE' || fdGR.getValue('state') == 'CANCELLED') return;

        fdGR.setValue('state', 'CANCELLED');
        fdGR.update();
        gs.info(LOG + flowDataId + ' → CANCELLED (for activity ' + targetState + ')');
    },

    /**
     * Cancels the backing flow context for a skipped/cancelled activity.
     */
    _cancelBackingFlow: function(fdContextId, reason) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._cancelBackingFlow: ';

        if (!fdContextId) return;

        var fcGR = new GlideRecord('sys_flow_context');
        if (!fcGR.get(fdContextId)) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'flow_context not found: ' + fdContextId);
            return;
        }

        var currentState = fcGR.getValue('state');
        if (currentState == 'COMPLETE' || currentState == 'CANCELLED') {
            gs.info(LOG + 'flow_context already terminal (' + currentState + ')');
            return;
        }

        fcGR.setWorkflow(false);
        fcGR.autoSysFields(false);
        fcGR.setValue('state', 'CANCELLED');
        fcGR.update();
        gs.info(LOG + 'cancelled flow_context ' + fdContextId + ' (reason: ' + reason + ')');
    },

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CONTEXT RESOLUTION (for context-level sync)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    CASE_TABLES: [
        'x_gegis_ins_policy_clearance_case',
        'x_gegis_ins_policy_risk_case',
        'x_gegis_ins_policy_exposure_case',
        'x_gegis_ins_policy_quote_and_bind_case',
        'x_gegis_ins_policy_renewal_case'
    ],

    _resolveCaseFromContext: function(contextGR) {
        var inputTable = contextGR.getValue('input_table');
        var inputRecord = contextGR.getValue('input_record');

        // Direct: input IS on a case table
        if (this.CASE_TABLES.indexOf(inputTable) > -1 && inputRecord) {
            return { table: inputTable, id: inputRecord };
        }

        // Nested: trace parent activity's playbook_inputs
        var parentActId = contextGR.getValue('parent_activity_context');
        if (parentActId) {
            return this._resolveCaseFromParentActivity(parentActId);
        }

        return null;
    },

    _resolveCaseFromParentActivity: function(parentActId) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._resolveCaseFromParentActivity: ';

        var actGR = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_activity_context');
        if (!actGR.get(parentActId)) return null;

        var inputsStr = actGR.getValue('inputs');
        if (!inputsStr) return null;

        try {
            var inputs = JSON.parse(inputsStr);
            if (!inputs.playbook_inputs || !inputs.playbook_inputs.value) return null;

            var pbInputs = JSON.parse(inputs.playbook_inputs.value);

            for (var key in pbInputs) {
                if (key == 'uiModel' || key == 'parent_record') continue;
                var variable = pbInputs[key];
                if (!variable || !variable.definition || !variable.definition.reference) continue;

                var refTable = variable.definition.reference;
                if (this.CASE_TABLES.indexOf(refTable) > -1 && variable.value) {
                    gs.info(LOG + 'found case: ' + refTable + ':' + variable.value);
                    return { table: refTable, id: variable.value };
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info(LOG + 'parse error: ' + e.getMessage());
        }

        // Trace up the chain
        var parentCtxId = actGR.getValue('context');
        if (parentCtxId) {
            var parentCtxGR = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_context');
            if (parentCtxGR.get(parentCtxId)) {
                return this._resolveCaseFromContext(parentCtxGR);
            }
        }

        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Finds sibling contexts: same process_definition, associated with same case,
     * still in active state.
     */
    _findSiblingContexts: function(processDefId, caseInfo, excludeContextId) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._findSiblingContexts: ';
        var siblings = [];

        // Strategy: find activities associated with this case in contexts
        // running the same process definition
        var actGR = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_activity_context');
        actGR.addQuery('associated_record', caseInfo.id);
        actGR.addQuery('context', '!=', excludeContextId);
        actGR.query();

        while (actGR.next()) {
            var ctxId = actGR.getValue('context');
            if (siblings.indexOf(ctxId) > -1) continue;

            // Verify context is active and same playbook
            var ctxGR = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_context');
            if (ctxGR.get(ctxId)) {
                if (ctxGR.getValue('state') == 'IN_PROGRESS' &&
                    ctxGR.getValue('process_definition') == processDefId) {
                    siblings.push(ctxId);
                }
            }
        }

        gs.info(LOG + 'found ' + siblings.length + ' siblings for case ' + caseInfo.id);
        return siblings;
    },

    _advanceContext: function(targetContextId, targetState) {
        var LOG = 'PlaybookActivitySync._advanceContext: ';

        var ctxGR = new GlideRecord('sys_pd_context');
        if (!ctxGR.get(targetContextId)) return;
        if (ctxGR.getValue('state') == targetState) return;

        ctxGR.setWorkflow(false);
        ctxGR.autoSysFields(false);
        ctxGR.setValue('state', targetState);
        ctxGR.update();
        gs.info(LOG + targetContextId + ' → ' + targetState);
    },

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // UTILITIES
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    /**
     * Extracts the sys_flow_data record ID from activity's experience_properties.
     */
    _getFlowDataId: function(actGR) {
        var expPropsStr = actGR.getValue('experience_properties');
        if (!expPropsStr) return null;

        try {
            var props = JSON.parse(expPropsStr);
            for (var i = 0; i < props.length; i++) {
                if (props[i].name == 'experience_status_record' && props[i].value) {
                    return props[i].value;
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info('PlaybookActivitySync._getFlowDataId: parse error');
        }

        return null;
    }
};
]]></script>
